prompt:
Background art for a 1990s point-and-click adventure game running on a 256-colour VGA PC at 320x200. Hand-painted pixel art: the whole picture is built from crisp square art pixels on one regular grid, as if a 320-pixel-wide screen were enlarged without smoothing; no anti-aliasing, no blur, no mixed pixel sizes. Painterly feel with smooth atmospheric colour gradients made of many closely spaced shades, sparse ordered dithering only where a gradient needs it (sky, haze). Lighting: deep blue-violet dusk sky, a warm orange band at the horizon, warm yellow lamp light from the cottage window and the lantern, cool blue-purple shadows, the lighthouse lamp glowing as a small bright yellow spot. Do not paint any light beams or rays from the lighthouse. Slightly stylised, friendly cartoon shapes of early-1990s adventure game backgrounds, readable silhouettes, dark coloured outlines only where needed, no pure black outlines. Side view with a fixed camera at standing eye level, like a theatre stage: the stone quay runs horizontally across the bottom of the picture as a walkable floor. Composition for a wide letterboxed game screen: all important content sits in the band between 15% and 85% of the image height. The top 15% is only empty dusk sky with a few stars, the bottom 15% is only plain stone paving of the quay. Horizon at about 48% of the height. The lighthouse on its rocky headland stands at the far right edge, its lamp at about 25% of the height; the harbour-master's cottage at the far left; between them open calm sea with long horizontal ripple highlights and the reflection of the orange horizon band; the wooden jetty and the two boats in the middle, barrels, crates, rope and the lantern post on the quay. Avoid: modern high-resolution digital painting, photorealism, 3D rendering, vector flat design, lens flare, bloom, light rays, blurry gradients.

Location: the small harbour of Lornholm, a fictional island in a northern sea, at dusk. A stone quay with a short wooden jetty runs along the lower third of the picture. Two small wooden fishing boats are moored at the jetty. On a rocky headland on the right stands a white lighthouse with one red band, its lamp lit. On the left a small stone harbour-master's cottage with a lit window and a smoking chimney. On the quay: two barrels, a stack of crates, a coil of rope and an iron lantern on a wooden post. Calm sea, low clouds, a band of orange light at the horizon, the first stars.

Leave the quay in the foreground free of characters: it is a game background, characters are added later as separate sprites.

No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.

Image format: landscape 3:2.
